logline: 말을 못 하는 하인이 그 집에서 유일하게 지키고 싶은 것을 갖게 되고, 그 때문에 쫓겨난다.
destination: 주인집 담장 — 쫓겨난 그가 밤마다 돌아와 서는 자리
protagonist: 오생원 집에서 자란 말 못 하는 하인
setting: 1920년대 서울 근교 기와집과 그 담장 밖 길
anchor: a short thickset mute servant in coarse hemp work clothes, close-cropped head, calloused hands
palette: deep tile grey, warm oil-lamp amber, cold night blue, dry courtyard dust

beats.visual: a thickset servant carrying two water buckets on a shoulder yoke across a tiled-roof courtyard
beats.motion: water sloshes over the rims, the yoke bends, his stride quickens

beats.beat: 주인집 아들이 손짓으로 그를 불러 세운다.
beats.visual: a young man in silk beckoning sharply at a servant across a courtyard, servant halting mid-step
beats.motion: the silk sleeve snaps as he beckons, the servant stops, dust settles

beats.beat: 새 색시가 가마에서 내려 마루에 오른다.
beats.visual: a bride in bright wedding silks stepping from a palanquin onto a wooden veranda, servant watching from a corner
beats.motion: her skirt spills over the step, the palanquin sways empty, a servant's head turns

beats.beat: 그는 색시의 신발을 말없이 닦아 놓는다.
beats.visual: a servant kneeling alone at a veranda edge polishing a pair of small embroidered shoes
beats.motion: his cloth circles on the leather, lamplight shifts, his head stays down

beats.beat: 밤마다 우는 소리를 그는 문밖에서 듣는다.
beats.visual: a servant standing motionless outside a lit paper door at night, head tilted toward it
beats.motion: the paper door glows and dims, his fists tighten, night wind crosses the yard

beats.visual: a servant holding out a small hand-sewn cloth pouch on his palm, a woman's hand reaching for it
beats.motion: his palm opens, her fingers close on the pouch, both hands tremble slightly

beats.beat: 그는 그 담을 다시 넘게 될까?
beats.visual: a servant looking up at a high tiled wall from the dark lane, faint glow rising beyond the roofline
beats.motion: the glow beyond the roof brightens, his head lifts, embers drift across the sky

beats.beat: 담장 아래 부시쌈지 하나가 놓여 있다.
beats.visual: a small hand-sewn cloth pouch lying on frosted ground beneath a high tiled wall at dawn
beats.motion: frost glitters as light touches it, a thread stirs, dust drifts along the wall

withheld: 불길 속에서 색시를 안고 지붕에 오르는 마지막 대목
